Claim 26 (Currently Amended): A non-aqueous composition comprising: a therapeutically effective amount of a non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drug (NSAID), said NSAID being admixed as a powder directly in a non-aqueous carrier wherein the non-aqueous carrier comprises a bio-compatible oil and from 20 wt.% to 80 wt.% phosphatidylcholine; the NSAID to non-aqueous carrier weight ratio is about 5:1 to about 1:5; and the NSAID is selected from the group consisting of a propionic acid NSAID, an acetic acid NSAID, and a salicylic acid NSAID, __wherein the phosphatidylcholine is present in an amount sufficient to reduce NSAID-associated gastro-intestinal ulceration and bleeding, and therapeutic activity of the NSAID for treatment of tissue inflammation, pain, and fever is preserved.__

Claim 50 (Currently Amended): A non-aqueous pharmaceutical composition comprising a biocompatible oil carrier including phosphatidylcholine and salicylate NSAID, said salicylate NSAID being admixed as a powder directly in the biocompatible oil carrier, said composition having a weight ratio of salicylate NSAID to biocompatible oil of about 5:1 to about 1:5, __wherein the salicylate NSAID is selected from the group consisting of aspirin and its derivatives.__

Claim 51 (Currently Amended): The non-aqueous pharmaceutical composition of claim 50 comprising from 10 wt % to 60 wt% phosphatidylcholine __as a phospholipid__.
